SPECIFICATION & FORMULA

Calculation Methodology

Contribution Margin = Price - COGS. Profit Margin % = Margin / Price. Break-Even ROAS = 1 / Profit Margin %. Break-Even CPA = Contribution Margin.

REFERENCE BASIS: Standard Industry Financial & Technical Formula • ASSUMPTIONS VERIFIED: 2026-10-27

Reference Notes & FAQ

Why is 2.0x ROAS sometimes unprofitable?

If your gross profit margin after COGS, shipping, and payment fees is 40%, your Break-Even ROAS is 1 / 0.40 = 2.50x. Any ROAS below 2.50x loses money on the first order.

What is Maximum Profitable CPA?

Your Maximum CPA is the exact dollar profit left from an average order after deducting all non-ad variable costs.
